title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：province　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 province 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the clerk ① governed the province that no applicant in the office would have noted, and he said the governing was the whole of the month. The ② province, meaning the region itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed unnoted in the book; a province, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ province in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ province at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A province, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the clerk said the noting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the province was the whole of the matter, meaning the home and not the region. The ⑥ province, meaning the home and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; province, he said, is either something you govern or the only word that means both a region and a home. He said the home is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ province had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ province of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of noting; province, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ province I remember is the region noted in the file, which closed in 1971 and is still noted as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ province, my mother said in 1973, is the only region that improves by being noted; every province, she said, is a home that has agreed to look like a region. She said the home was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 省；省份（指办事处里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 省；省份（指那个省本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：govern the province 治理这一个省
D. n. 省；省份（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 省之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的省之事）
F. n. 省；省份（指卷宗里写到、被记下的那一个）
G. n. 省、乡邦（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 乡邦（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: governed the province that no applicant in the office would have noted
The province, meaning the region itself and not the stamp
the province at the far counter
the province was the whole of the matter

The province of the whole thing
A province, my mother said in 1973

answers.why: govern the province 意为“治理这一个省”，1964 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯记下的一个省做了一遍。
province 意为“省；省份”，指那个省本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记下。
province 意为“省；省份”，指办事处里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
province 意为“省；省份”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
province 意为“省、乡邦”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个乡邦就是那件事的全部。
province 意为“乡邦”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个省，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
province 意为“省；省份”，指卷宗里写到、被记下的那一个，到 1969 年这一个成了卷宗里的一行。
province 意为“省之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的省之事是一处办事处和三个月份的记下。
province 意为“省；省份”，我记得的是卷宗里记下过的那一个，1971 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一个。
province 为抽象总称，母亲 1973 年说，省是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的省。
